page.overview:
Who is Porter?

is the tritagonist of The Puppet Carver, the first story of Fazbear Frights 9: The Puppet Carver.

Porter works as a employee at Pizza Playground alongside Sage Brantley, Porter constantly gets yelled at by his boss Jack due to slacking. One day Porter proudly tells his boss about a machine he has been working on. After a while Porter attempts to show his machine to his boss, but it breaks down. Jack fires all of his employees including Porter. Eventually he gets rehired. Porter then decides to work on a newer version of his machine.
